versions.changelog: Security fix: parameterize learning statistics date filters and validate day-window inputs before database queries.

- Expanded skill description and usage scenarios in SKILL.md for greater clarity.
- Added an optional PATH setup step to the installation section in SKILL.md.
- Cleaned up repository by removing 10 files, mainly legacy source code and metadata.
- Updated documentation for improved detail and organization.

Initial release of Learning Planner: a personal learning management system.

- Set and manage learning goals, skill trees, priorities, and deadlines.
- Generate auto-adjusting daily/weekly study plans and receive learning reminders.
- Track learning progress in real-time with visual charts and statistics.
- Leverage an integrated spaced repetition (SM-2 algorithm) review system.
- Organize resources, link them to learning goals, and analyze usage.
- Assess learning outcomes through self-assessment, test scores, and growth analysis.
- Command-line interface powered by Python, SQLite, Click, and Rich.
